scope: Automatic live numeric factor provider for supported native enemy births, source Buffer resets and descendants; not a complete EntityService/evolution/area port.
sourceFacts: Source Enemy.init_current_stats reads health, damage and speed in order before init_effect_behaviors; source births are not burning at this first stat read.

NativeEnemyStats captures actual RunDirector participants/options and StatService enemyHp/enemyDamage/enemySpeed/Curse. Danger/endless use existing audited source rules; all-DLC target has the Curse key.

Speed is primed on the unburned birth before enemy effects, so burningSpeed is explicitly neutral in that initial context and never substituted as a dynamic per-burn modifier. Raw numeric cache still preserves first-caller burning semantics for explicit callers.

Numeric contexts are invalidated on run start/end, Shop cleanup, Running entry (including same-wave restart signal), and authoritative wave-id change. Original reset_cache enemy-time side effect is not implemented by this stat provider.

focused.NativeEnemyStatsProvider: 8/0; first6cases initially0/6, first implementation5/1 due uncontrolled test speed randomization; controlled source roll corrected fixture, not runtime math

proof: Single shared cache/context serves hostile and friendly actors. Legacy births establish global first-use factors too, without replacing their caller-supplied multipliers.
Actual danger3 launch with HP75%/damage125%/speed75% gives global factors1.092/1.512/.75; source Triceratops actually spawns76HP/2contact/195px/s with a controlled original speed draw.

Two actual players with speed+10/-20 multiply to.88, not legacy sum.9; native Gallimimus has8HP/220px/s. Native -95% enemy HP uses.05 before co-op, creating Triceratops5HP rather than the legacy.1 floor. Explicit debug99 multipliers remain396HP on Gallimimus.
Existing SpawnDirector.spawnAt dispatches supported normal/native/current-wave births to EnemySim.spawnNative. Gloom/affix/custom-time requests retain their old explicit path.

Real Corrupted Buffer pulse invokes actual applyNativeBoost through World.Params.nativeStatBoost and the shared run cache; later+100% team enemyHp does not change cached target20HP/2contact in that wave. Custom/unported actors retain saved-input fallback.
Actual next-wave and new-run flows refresh context, including restarting at wave1; a separate same-wave Running signal verifies invalidation without wave-id change.

Real boosted source BloatedSpawner produces5 native-policy DireJunkies with20HP and no parental boost; inherited sourceFactors policy reaches the existing child factory. Hostile and Charm child factories share the supported native path.

interfaces: EnemySim.NativeEnemyStats.get(wave)->shared cache/context, clear()->numeric lifecycle invalidation; lazy StatService/RunDirector reads avoid service require cycles.
EnemySim.spawnNative(enemyId,x,z)->id? uses cached source global factors/current wave for explicitly supported source kinds in active runs.
World.Params.nativeStatBoost(id,factors)->handled? lets the source run provider own a native pulse; saved-input fallback remains for explicit/custom actors.
SpawnContext.sourceFactors optional internal inherited policy; no Remote/snapshot/schema changes.
limits: This is the supported native actor stat path, not all legacy actor/global environmental producers or a complete EntityService port. Explicit custom multipliers remain explicit.
Original reset_cache also stops enemy time; source global time effects, extra registered projectile/profile reset and other effect systems remain separate open work.
No evolved selector/flags/effect execution/attack profiles/reliable variant renderer state enabled, and Jungle groups/bosses/area/Whip-Flail route remain incomplete.
No native frame/solver/Area/pooling/render/Studio/two-client/mobile acceptance; no new Remote/Arsenal/uploads/runtime IDs.
